top_signals.title: Fortescue Says Dispute With China’s CMRG Hits Iron Ore Sales
top_signals.summary: Iron ore miner Fortescue Ltd. said sales fell, as a standoff with state-backed buyer China Mineral Resources Group Co. over long-term supply contracts and price negotiations drags on.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
